body.statement: Using the covariance-set Gaussian receipt handle, determine whether one can construct a terminating \(\varepsilon\)-certificate for \(\inf_{r\in\Delta_K(\rho)}\sup_{\lambda\in\Lambda(f,\mu_0)}G(\Sigma(r,\lambda))\) and \(\inf_{p\in\Delta_K}\sup_{\lambda\in\Lambda(f,\mu_0)}G(\Sigma(Bp,\lambda))\), returning outward value brackets, all minimizing design cells, and explicit covariance and selector witnesses without assuming that \(\Xi\) is identified or that common thinning rescales \(G\).
body.justification: This is the genuinely open step from a sharp pairwise-risk design to the exact all-selector minimax-regret design.
body.gap: Joo2025 fixes one covariance matrix, GuggenbergerHuang2025 approximates one minimax game, and GaoGeQian2025 optimizes coupling functionals; none couples all three optimizations in an exact-hit experimental-design certificate.
body.consumer: A positive answer would replace the conservative pairwise surrogate in the Kenya design calculation by the exact robust policy-selection value.
